recorded: by rig/scenarios/claude-prompts.sh: the real claude binary in a rig hc terminal, private HOME, a scripted fake Anthropic API on the rig loopback, no network, no credentials; all content fake

files.permission: Bash permission dialog (default mode). Options: Yes / Yes, and don’t ask again for: cargo test * / Yes, and switch to auto mode / No. Footer: Esc to cancel · Tab to amend
files.ask-single: AskUserQuestion, one question, single select. 3 options + "Type something." (Other) + "Chat about this" below a rule
files.ask-other: ask-single with the cursor on the Other row ("4. Type something."): typing there is the Other input
files.ask-multi: AskUserQuestion multiSelect: rows "[ ]", an unnumbered "Submit" row after the Other row, tab bar with Submit tab
files.ask-multi-after-space: after one space on row 1: "[✔] Lint"; the tab icon changed from ☐ to ☒
files.ask-multi-after-down-enter: after down then enter on row 2: both rows toggled; Enter toggles too
files.ask-multi-on-submit: cursor on the unnumbered Submit row
files.ask-multi-review: Enter on Submit opens a review step: "Submit answers" / "Cancel"; a second Enter answers
files.plan: ExitPlanMode in plan mode: plan text, then "Yes, and use auto mode" / "Yes, manually approve edits" / "Tell Claude what to change"
files.stop-idle: CV8: idle claude, nothing in flight; footer "? for shortcuts"
files.stop-idle-after-esc: stop-idle after one Esc: unchanged (Esc does nothing when idle with an empty composer)
files.stop-idle-after-double-esc: then Esc Esc in one hc keys call with no history: unchanged
files.stop-working-stream: working while a reply streams ("H0-SLOW"): spinner line, footer "⏸ manual mode on · esc to interrupt · ← for agents"; hc get says status.state "working"
files.stop-stream-after-esc: one Esc while streaming: "⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?", footer back to "? for shortcuts"
files.stop-after-stop-double-esc: two Escs 300 ms apart, 2 s after an interrupt (idle with a history): the Rewind menu opens (Claude Code’s double-Esc)
files.stop-working-tool: working while a Bash call runs ("H0-TOOL", allowed): footer "esc to interrupt"; hc get "working"
files.stop-tool-after-esc: one Esc while the tool runs: the call gets an error result, "Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?"
files.stop-permission-after-esc: one Esc on a permission prompt: the prompt is cancelled (call rejected, turn interrupted). Why Stop refuses while a prompt is open
files.stop-second-esc-300ms: one second Esc 300 ms after the Esc that interrupted the agent: no Rewind (nor at 1 s, 2 s, 3.5 s: manifest stop.secondEsc)
files.stop-second-esc-3500ms: the same, 3.5 s after: no Rewind
files.stop-working-draft: working, with a desk draft "draft" in the composer: herdr-core "working", but the footer drops "esc to interrupt" (just "⏸ manual mode on")
files.stop-draft-after-esc: one Esc with that draft: the agent is interrupted and the draft stays in the composer
files.askq-q1: CV9: AskUserQuestion with three questions (H0-ASKQ: single, multi-select, single). The block opens with the tab line "←  ☐ Approach  ☐ Checks  ☐ Target  ✔ Submit  →", then question 1 shaped as ask-single
files.askq-q2: right on question 1: question 2, multi-select: boxes, the Other row "[ ] Type something", an unnumbered "Next" row, "Chat about this" below a rule
files.askq-review-unanswered: right twice more: the Submit tab with nothing answered: "Review your answers", "⚠ You have not answered all questions", 1. Submit answers / 2. Cancel
files.askq-q1-typed: a letter typed with the cursor on option 1: nothing changed
files.askq-after-esc: one Esc on question 1: the whole prompt is cancelled (the call gets a rejection)
files.askq-q1-on-option2: down on question 1: cursor on option 2
files.askq-q2-after-enter: Enter there: option 2 picked, question 2 shown, tab line "☒ Approach"
files.askq-q2-ticked: space, down down space: rows 1 and 3 ticked, "☒ Checks"
files.askq-q2-on-next: down twice more: cursor on the unnumbered Next row ("❯    Next")
files.askq-q3-after-next: Enter on Next: question 3 shown, the ticks kept
files.askq-q3-on-other: down down: cursor on question 3's Other row "3. Type something."; footer adds "ctrl+g to edit in VS Code"
files.askq-review: hc send --force on that row: the text is question 3's answer and the review shows: "● <question>" / "→ <answer>" per question (ticks joined with ", "), every tab ☒, cursor on Submit answers
files.askq-q3-revisit: left on the review: question 3 again, its cursor back on row 1 (a single-select pick shows as "Label ✔" when a tab is shown again)
files.askq-after-submit: right, then Enter on Submit answers: the prompt is answered (tool_result lists every answer)
files.askq-q2-after-other: hc send --force on question 1's Other row: the text is question 1's answer, question 2 shown
files.askq-q2-other-typed: a letter typed on question 2's Other row: "[✔] y" (typing ticks a multi-select Other)
files.askr-q1: CV9: two questions (H0-ASKR: single, then multi-select last), tab line "←  ☐ Branch  ☐ Docs  ✔ Submit  →"
files.askr-q2-on-submit: the last question, multi-select: its unnumbered row is "Submit", not "Next"; cursor on it
files.askr-review: Enter on that Submit: the review
files.askr-after-esc: one Esc on the review: the whole prompt is cancelled (the call gets a rejection)

keys.multiSelectToggle: space or enter toggles the row under the cursor; down moves; Submit is the row after Other; Enter on it opens a review step with 1. Submit answers / 2. Cancel
keys.other: hc send is refused while the terminal is blocked on a dialog (kind "blocked"); hc send --force on the Other row pastes the text and answers
keys.cursor: the cursor ❯ must be searched only inside the block below the last full-width rule (the echoed user message also starts with ❯ at column 0); its column differs per dialog: 0 (ask), 1 (permission), 3 (plan)
keys.multiSelectPlusOther: RECORDED by CV9 (multiQuestion.multiOther): typing on a multi-select's "[ ] Type something" row ticks the box, Enter there toggles it, and hc send (paste + Enter) leaves it unticked. The bridge still refuses Other on a multi-select: it needs a key sequence of its own

stop.workingSignal: herdr-core status.state "working" (hc get) and the footer segment "esc to interrupt" on the last screen line; idle shows "? for shortcuts" there; blocked on a prompt: status.state "blocked", kind "permission"

transcript.whileStreaming: a user turn with one text block "[Request interrupted by user]"
transcript.whileTool: the call gets tool_result is_error true (toolUseResult "User rejected tool use"), then a user turn "[Request interrupted by user for tool use]"
transcript.onPermissionPrompt: the same as whileTool: Esc cancels the dialog and the call

stop.doubleEsc: two Escs 300 ms apart on an idle agent with a history open the Rewind menu (stop-after-stop-double-esc); one second Esc 300 ms, 1 s, 2 s or 3.5 s after the interrupting one does not. Stop’s 3 s cooldown is a margin against pairing, not a measured window
stop.deskDraft: a desk draft hides "esc to interrupt" from the footer while herdr still says working; one Esc interrupts and keeps the draft. With no hint on screen, Stop refuses (desk_draft), and its post-check never counts a screen with a draft as stopped

multiQuestion.recorded: by rig/scenarios/claude-multiq.sh (claude-multiq-harness.mjs): the same rig, fake API scripts H0-ASKQ and H0-ASKR; files askq-* and askr-*
multiQuestion.keys: right / tab: next tab; left / shift+tab: previous tab (no wrap on question 1; right stays on the Submit tab); up/down move the cursor; Enter on a single-select option picks it and shows the next tab; space (or Enter) toggles a multi-select row; Enter on "Next" (or "Submit" on the last question) shows the next tab; hc send --force on a single-select Other row picks the text and shows the next tab; the last question answered shows the review; Enter on "Submit answers" answers the call
multiQuestion.activeTab: the tab line does not show which tab is active in hc read (only the shown question text does): ☐ unanswered, ☒ answered (a multi-select tab turns ☒ with its first tick)
multiQuestion.typing: a printable key on an option row changes nothing; the bridge never types except the confirmed Other send
multiQuestion.esc: Esc on a question cancels the whole AskUserQuestion: the call gets a rejection result
multiQuestion.multiOther: on a multi-select Other row, typing ticks the box, Enter toggles it, and hc send (paste + Enter) leaves it unticked: multi-select + Other needs a key sequence of its own (not offered)
multiQuestion.lastRow: a multi-select question ends in an unnumbered "Next" row, or "Submit" when it is the last question; Enter on either moves on (Next: the next question; Submit: the review)
multiQuestion.reviewEsc: Esc on the review cancels the whole AskUserQuestion: the call gets a rejection result
multiQuestion.sendWait: on one question of several, hc send --force pastes and presses Enter at once (the next tab shows within about 0.8 s) and then waits about 5 s for a turn to start, which never comes, returning "started":false; on a one-question prompt the answer starts a turn and hc returns in under a second. So the bridge times the Other send of a card with several questions by when the next tab shows, not by when hc returns
